description: Minimal IPC for Hey TA webviews (overlay, dashboard, capture overlays). core:default enables Tauri invoke to app-defined Rust commands, core:event listen/unlisten (streaming chat events), and the bundled core path/event/window(read)/webview/app defaults—nothing extra for menus/tray/opener. core:window:allow-start-dragging is required so the overlay bar can be repositioned; other window mutations (show/hide/focus/size/close) are performed from Rust, not from the frontend, so those JS permissions are omitted. Opener and global-shortcut are omitted: external links stay in-webview; global shortcuts are registered in Rust at startup, not via the JS plugin API.
